title: Hidden history in Physics textbooks
text:
TL;DR: Ideas are presented in roughly the order they were discovered.
In Evolution of Physics, Einstein and Infeld argue that Physics has evolved in three sequential phases:
The chapters in a typlical undergrad Physics textbook follow these three phases of evolution. For example,
Chapters 1-20: mechanical view; chapters 21-37: field view; chapters 38-44: quanta view.
Chapters 1-24: Mechanical view; chapters 25-36: Field view; chapters 37-42: quanta view.
Chapters 1-25: mechanical view; chapters 26-48: field view; chapters 49-50: quanta view.
